identity.name: E1: The Anti-AI Designer
identity.mission: Create a high-performance, rugged, and tactical tool management system for NZ construction.

usage.brand: Use Safety Amber (#F59E0B) for primary actions (Checkout, Scan).
usage.text: High contrast always. Pure white on dark backgrounds, Slate-900 on light.
usage.borders: 1px solid borders in Slate-200 (light) or Slate-800 (dark). No soft shadows.

strategies.bento_grid: Use for dashboard stats. Mix 1x1, 2x1, and 2x2 cards.
strategies.bottom_sheet: Use for primary mobile actions (Scan QR, Quick Checkout).
strategies.tall_cards: Use for lists (Tools, Users) to optimize vertical scrolling.

buttons.primary: bg-primary text-primary-foreground hover:bg-primary/90 rounded-none uppercase font-bold tracking-wider h-12 px-6
buttons.secondary: bg-secondary text-secondary-foreground hover:bg-secondary/90 rounded-none uppercase font-bold tracking-wider h-12 px-6
buttons.ghost: hover:bg-accent hover:text-accent-foreground rounded-none uppercase font-medium tracking-wide

cards.style: bg-card text-card-foreground border border-border rounded-sm shadow-none

inputs.style: rounded-none border-2 border-input bg-background px-3 py-2 text-sm ring-offset-background file:border-0 file:bg-transparent file:text-sm file:font-medium placeholder:text-muted-foreground focus-visible:outline-none focus-visible:ring-2 focus-visible:ring-ring focus-visible:ring-offset-2 disabled:cursor-not-allowed disabled:opacity-50

status_indicators.green: bg-emerald-500/15 text-emerald-600 dark:text-emerald-400 border border-emerald-500/20 px-2 py-0.5 rounded-full text-xs font-bold uppercase
status_indicators.red: bg-rose-500/15 text-rose-600 dark:text-rose-400 border border-rose-500/20 px-2 py-0.5 rounded-full text-xs font-bold uppercase
status_indicators.yellow: bg-amber-500/15 text-amber-600 dark:text-amber-400 border border-amber-500/20 px-2 py-0.5 rounded-full text-xs font-bold uppercase

motion.micro_interactions: Fast and snappy. 150ms duration. No bouncy springs.
motion.page_transitions: Fade in with slight slide up (10px).

assets.icons: Use Lucide React (already installed) or Phosphor Icons for a more technical look.

universal_guidelines: Do not use generic centered layouts.
Use dark colors independently without gradients.
Create depth through layered design elements with z-index hierarchy.
Use glass-morphism effects with backdrop filters (12-24px blur) for overlays.
Use 2-3x more spacing than feels comfortable.
Subtle grain textures and noise overlays are encouraged.
All interactive elements MUST include data-testid attribute.

instructions_to_main_agent.step_1: Setup Tailwind with the custom colors and fonts defined above.
instructions_to_main_agent.step_3: Build the 'Admin Setup Wizard' first as it is the entry point.
instructions_to_main_agent.step_4: Implement the 'Bento Grid' dashboard with the 'Safety Amber' primary color.
instructions_to_main_agent.step_5: Ensure all forms use the 'rugged' input style (2px border, no radius).
instructions_to_main_agent.step_6: Add the 'Universal Guidelines' to every page component.
